# cleaner

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-bots/cmd/cleaner"
```

Command cleaner keeps a repository's Actions footprint small — the environments\-cleaner bot. Its first task prunes old workflow runs, which otherwise fill the self\-hosted runner node's disk.

```
cleaner runs    delete completed workflow runs beyond the newest N per
                workflow
```

GitHub is reached with the token in GH\_TOKEN \(or GITHUB\_TOKEN\), normally an installation token of the BlanketOps Environments Cleaner App \(Actions read and write\).
